water_vision.water_vision.scaleClose.des: Distance from the camera where the fog starts.
water_vision.water_vision.scaleFar.desc: Distance from the camera where the fog ends.
water_vision.water_vision.enableTransiti: Enables the brightness fading when entering / leaving water. If set to false it will be instant.
water_vision.water_vision.transitionMult: How fast should the fade be. Smaller number is faster.
water_vision.water_vision.transitionLeav: How fast should the fade be when leaving water. Smaller number is slower.
